issues.description: React hydration errors causing entire root to switch to client rendering. Text content mismatch between server and client HTML on multiple elements.
issues.element: Budget tier cards / price range text
issues.root_cause: Likely a currency formatter or number formatter (e.g., toLocaleString()) that produces different output on server vs client, or a Date/random value used in rendering. In apps/web/app/design/step-5/page.tsx, price ranges may be formatted using locale-dependent methods.

issues.description: Budget tier cards are missing description text — only price range and tier name visible, no descriptive text shown on cards.
issues.root_cause: Description text may not be rendered in the card component or is hidden due to card height/overflow constraints in apps/web/app/design/step-5/page.tsx.

issues.description: Continue button is not visible on screen. Expected a Continue button to proceed to next step.
issues.root_cause: Continue button may be positioned below the card carousel and off-screen, or conditionally rendered only after a selection is made. Since no card is selected (no gold border visible on first card despite it being centered), the button may be hidden.

fixes.reason: Ensure client-side hooks are imported to allow suppressing hydration mismatches
Replace em-dash with en-dash and ensure the string is a static literal to avoid server/client hydration mismatch from locale-sensitive formatting
Normalize price range separator to static en-dash to prevent hydration mismatch
